method: Pinned release JS on one machine, paired in both initial orders. Ordinary uses three process pairs with nine 500-call samples after three warmups each. Deep uses four process pairs with nine 16-call samples after three warmups each. CLI records nine paired samples after two warmup pairs, including startup and peak RSS. Same-binary control uses the identical baseline on both sides.

probe.method: Counts cover successful root compilation. Whole-call and segmented timers run in separate processes. Individual phases subtract an empty timing interval at the same location. The probe includes warmups and its estimates are approximate.
